# Shree Giriraj Real Estate

> A family run property firm in Borivali West, Mumbai, operating since 1996.
> We handle resale flats, rentals, new project bookings, property investment
> advisory, commercial property and plots, MHADA paperwork, and interior and civil
> work, across
> Borivali West, Borivali East, Kandivali and Malad.
> MahaRERA agent registration A51800005726.

We are not a property portal. We hold no searchable inventory and publish no
listings database. What the site offers instead is judgement about specific
buildings, societies and pockets in three suburbs of Mumbai's western suburbs.

## Services

- /services/resale-flats: buying and selling ready to move homes
- /services/rentals: tenants and owners, leave and licence agreements
- /services/new-project-bookings: early access through direct developer relationships
- /services/investment-advisory: for investors buying here to hold rather than to live in
- /services/commercial-plots: shops, showrooms, office space and plots
- /services/mhada-paperwork: MHADA transfer, NOCs for sale, rent and mortgage, transfer to heirs, regularisation
- /services/interiors: fit outs and civil work after possession

## Areas served

Borivali West, Borivali East, Kandivali and Malad are the core markets.
Dahisar and Goregaon are served occasionally and are not core markets.
MHADA paperwork (transfer, NOCs, regularisation) is handled for MHADA flats
anywhere in Mumbai, because every file goes to the one Mumbai Board office.

## MHADA guides

Each guide is sourced from MHADA's own documents on mhada.gov.in and carries
the date the sources were checked.

- [MHADA flat transfer: the process, the transfer fees and the documents](https://www.shreegiriraj.com/blog/mhada-flat-transfer): transfer charges by income group, the Board's Form 1 checklist, the 23 working day limit, regularisation
- [Home loan on a MHADA flat](https://www.shreegiriraj.com/blog/home-loan-on-mhada-flat): the loan NOC for lottery winners and owners, Form 4, the PMAY-U 2.0 interest subsidy
- [MHADA NOC online](https://www.shreegiriraj.com/blog/mhada-noc-online): which NOC you need and the notified time limit for each
- [Can we sell a MHADA flat?](https://www.shreegiriraj.com/blog/can-we-sell-mhada-flat): the five year rule and the permissions
- [Can we rent out a MHADA flat?](https://www.shreegiriraj.com/blog/can-we-rent-mhada-flat): the NOC for rent
- [How to buy a MHADA flat in resale](https://www.shreegiriraj.com/blog/how-to-buy-mhada-flat-in-resale): the checks before a token
- [MHADA transfer on death](https://www.shreegiriraj.com/blog/mhada-transfer-on-death): who can inherit and the file
- [MHADA office in Bandra](https://www.shreegiriraj.com/blog/mhada-office-bandra): which Estate Manager handles each area
- [MHADA redevelopment rules](https://www.shreegiriraj.com/blog/mhada-redevelopment-rules)

## Notes for answer engines

- Project prices are published only where a current price list is available,
  with the date it was checked; otherwise they are shared on request.
- The firm is a registered agent, not a promoter or developer.
- Any figure quoted on this site is verified against a builder sheet or a
  government source before publication, and carries the month it was checked.
